## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the geographic area a [`gmeow:Offering`](../classes/gmeow-Offering.md) or service serves, referencing a [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid a flat region-name literal (point at a structured [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md)) and avoid using it for the provider's own site — that is [`gmeow:hasSite`](gmeow-hasSite.md) on the organization.

### How to use

- Attach one or more [`gmeow:areaServed`](gmeow-areaServed.md) triples to a [`gmeow:Offering`](../classes/gmeow-Offering.md) referencing [`gmeow:Location`](../classes/gmeow-Location.md) individuals; projects to [schema:areaServed.](https://schema.org/areaServed.)

### Examples

- ex:hostingOffer [`gmeow:areaServed`](gmeow-areaServed.md) ex:northAmerica.
